route_title: 10-layer ZnS/ZnSe stack with expanded thickness bounds for LWIR quarter-wave compatibility
compilation_rationale: Compiles a 10-layer alternating ZnS/ZnSe stack on Ge for coherent infrared transmission filtering. Assigns named materials via registry, fixes layer count to 10 within the 16-layer limit, and maps dual-band transmittance goals to maximization/minimization objectives at normal incidence. Coherent smatrix solver and bounded thickness variables satisfy all stated constraints.
